mapper.select: select v.*, r.rno, p.name as place_name from visit v join place p on v.pno=p.pno left join review r on v.vno = r.vno where v.mno= #{mno} order by v.reg_date desc

select v.vno, m.nickname, p.name AS placeName, v.visit_date, v.receipt, v.status, v.reg_date from visit v join member m on v.mno = m.mno join place p on p.pno = v.pno where v.status = 0 order by v.reg_date desc
mapper.update: update visit set status = 1 where vno = #{vno} and status = 0
update visit set status = 2 where vno = #{vno} and status =0
